name: Minixx's Clippy
description: Instant replay for Geometry Dash on iOS. Clippy keeps the last seconds of your game in memory and saves the moment when you die at a high percent, set a new best or beat a level.

auto-start.name: Start the buffer with the game
auto-start.description: Starts the rolling buffer when the main menu opens. iOS asks for screen-recording permission every launch.

buffer-seconds.name: Buffer length (seconds)
buffer-seconds.description: How much footage is kept in memory.

codec.name: Codec
codec.description: HEVC gives smaller files at the same quality.

rotation.name: Rotation fix
rotation.description: Use this if your clips come out sideways or upside down.

on-death.name: Clip deaths
on-death.description: Save a clip when you die past the minimum percent.

death-percent.name: Minimum percent
death-percent.description: Deaths below this percent are ignored.

on-best.name: Clip new bests
on-best.description: Save a clip when you beat your best percent.

best-min-percent.name: New bests from
best-min-percent.description: New bests below this percent are ignored.

on-complete.name: Clip completions
on-complete.description: Save a clip when you beat a level.

practice.name: Clip practice runs
practice.description: Also clip deaths and completions in practice mode.

preroll.name: Pre-roll (seconds)
preroll.description: Extra footage kept before the run starts.

postroll.name: Post-roll (seconds)
postroll.description: Extra footage kept after the death.

manual-seconds.name: Manual clip length (seconds)
manual-seconds.description: Length of a clip made with the Clip button.

max-clip-seconds.name: Max clip length (seconds)
max-clip-seconds.description: Automatic clips are cut to this length.

max-clips.name: Clips to keep
max-clips.description: Oldest clips are deleted beyond this number.

mascot.name: Clippy reactions
mascot.description: Show Clippy and his speech bubble when a clip is saved.

ingame-toast.name: Reactions while playing
ingame-toast.description: Off by default so Clippy never ends up inside your next clip.

haptics.name: Haptics
haptics.description: A small vibration when a clip is saved.
